exposure: Source identities and five pairings known. Earlier project exposure to these sources and general expected motifs disclosed by METHOD; not a blind botanical identification. No reviewer B or root native notes read before completing and writing these ten independent observations.
observation_protocol: Native visual inspection of all ten exact-hash full-page JPEGs, in numerical sequence; no OCR, reconstruction, target Voynich images or text. Full pages viewed, no derived crops. YES for container describes visible same-scene cylinders only; plant attachment must be assessed separately and is not asserted. NO means no positively identifiable attached instance in visible parts, not proof about occluded regions.
